findings.rationale: Accepted: the non-empty-string fallback let a managed review silently run on the legacy whole-diff copy. §1.1 now has NO fallback — a missing identity blocks with phase prepare_review / 'review packet identity unavailable' BEFORE reviewDiff is called.

Accepted: reviewDiff forwarded input.reviewOptions verbatim. New §1.1b: reviewDiff always deletes reviewOptions.packet and sets it only from the engine-derived input.packet; tests (b) now supply a bogus caller packet on both the managed path (must be replaced) and the direct path (must be absent), plus a malformed input.packet → prepare_review block.
Accepted: §4 packet-identity-surfaced said null while §1.2 said absent. The acceptance row now requires absence (never null) with hasOwnProperty asserted both ways.

Accepted: §4.1 lists the thirteen exact commands (also the graph verification_commands), the run context (candidate checkout on a temp branch, root cwd, sequential), expected exit 0; the same set is run at bee8da3d and recorded as docs/plans/evidence/2026-09-17-blind-review-packet-engine/base-suites-bee8da3d.txt, committed with the plan.
